# Bulk Apothecary

> > Wholesale supplier of private label products, custom packaging, printable labels, and DIY supplies for cosmetics, candles, and personal care manufacturing.

Bulk Apothecary provides wholesale ingredients, containers, labels, and ready-to-brand products for small businesses and artisans in the beauty, wellness, and candle-making industries. The site specializes in FDA-compliant labeling solutions, HDPE/BOPP packaging materials, and private label formulations including natural deodorants, bath products, and hair care.

## Key Topics

- Private Label Products
- Custom Labels & Digital Printing
- BOPP & Waterproof Labels
- HDPE Plastic Containers
- Candle Making Supplies
- Natural & Organic Ingredients
- FDA-Compliant Packaging
- Inkjet Printable Labels
- Wholesale Packaging Solutions
- Bath & Body Product Formulations
- Coconut Oil & Cocamidopropyl Betaine
- Circle & Oval Label Formats
- Bamboo Lid Containers
- Soap Molds & DIY Supplies
